findings.statement: Qualified standard-7x6 q_o is a rank-local sufficient representation for complete orientation-sensitive literal-action ordinary future behavior.
findings.scope: qualified Connect4 authority 1.2, legal nonterminal standard 7x6

findings.statement: Qualified q_r, the horizontal-reflection orbit of q_o with explicit action transporter, is a rank-local sufficient representation for exact scalar ordinary value and future-game correspondence up to reflection transport, but not literal action-label identity.
Across the four complete bounded controls, q_o successor state was independently derived from q_o + literal move + G on 385862 legal nonterminal edges with zero mismatches to the physical child q_o.
q_o is future-behavior sufficient but not coarsest on every tested bounded domain: each case has strictly more distinct q_o representations than complete literal future-behavior classes.
findings.guard: bounded exact result; does not prove standard-7x6 nonminimality

findings.statement: Support alone, support plus only one player's residuals, owned residuals without support, support plus unowned residual union, residual-size histograms, GF(2)-rank summaries, and residual cell-incidence histograms all fail both complete-future and scalar-value sufficiency on every tested case.

Physical horizontal-reflection quotient q_r is scalar-value sufficient on every tested bounded case but is not literal-action future-behavior sufficient on any of them. Future-behavior and scalar-value minimality must therefore remain separate research targets.

A finite rank-well-founded Bellman evaluator supplies one exact D_G once a sufficient ordinary-state carrier is fixed; this establishes evaluator existence without constraining the final evaluator to recursive form.

Existing exact RBA work represents tested threshold Bellman transformers as monotone lattice polynomials over an idempotent antichain semiring, with exact local-skyline factorization of semiring multiplication. This proves nontrivial exact algebraic structure in D_G on those boundary carriers, but not a root-scale direct closed form.
findings.scope: qualified/current exact RBA relations and tested support-local threshold boundaries

findings.statement: The prior canonical-frame two-sheet cocycle is not a valid shortcut to a minimal Q_G: its witness fibers collapse at literal-future resolution, action-token recursion omitted transporter alignment, and arbitrary canonical slots are not generally physical board columns.
